decisions.reason: The air quality sensor module is a current-generation module in the platform's core measurement line, and indoor air monitoring remains in demand.
As the latest generation of the analog input module, it is a basic building block with no successor in sight.
Native MQTT support in the bindings may make the separate proxy redundant, but it costs little to keep available for existing users.
The CAN interface serves industrial and automotive users and would most likely be replaced only by a new hardware revision.
CO2 sensing has strong demand for indoor climate and ventilation uses, so the module stays relevant.
This low-maintenance accessory complements the display modules, though component shortages add some risk.
